name: calc_beta
description:
Beta of a stock against the market: covariance of the two return series divided by the market's variance; the longer series is cut to the length of the shorter. Computed locally in Python; no API key or network.
Returns {beta, data_points}: beta to 4 decimals (1 if market variance is 0).
Inputs (* required): stock_returns*, market_returns* (arrays of periodic returns in the same unit and order, e.g. daily percent).
Use the beta in calc_capm; for plain co-movement use calc_correlation.
Example: {"stock_returns": [1.2, -0.5, 0.8, 2.1, -1.0], "market_returns": [0.9, -0.3, 0.5, 1.5, -0.8]}

stock_returns.description: Periodic returns of the stock, in time order

market_returns.description: Periodic returns of the market, same unit and order
